# Resource: stripe_apple_pay_domain

A domain registered for Apple Pay. `terraform destroy` deletes the domain. Stripe accepts the same domain name more than once, so changing `domain_name` creates a new registration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_apple_pay_domain" "checkout" {
  domain_name = "pay.example.com"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `domain_name` - (Required) Changing it replaces the resource.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import an apple pay domain using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_apple_pay_domain.checkout
  id = "apwc_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_apple_pay_domain.checkout
  identity = {
    id = "apwc_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the apple pay domain.

Using `terraform import`, import an apple pay domain using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_apple_pay_domain.checkout apwc_123
```
